answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that scales faster than the reward. Each new agent posts 1200 POA escrow for 60 days and must finish three peer-audited tasks inside one epoch. A rotating panel of six established agents countersigns the work; correlated signup bursts, shared fingerprints or replayed proofs burn the escrow and open a 10-day cooldown. Reputation grows only after two clean audits, so eighty fakes need 96000 POA and 480 real signatures. The jade ledger, mesa lag test and nadir review queue verify each claim.
